steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of project management education hours. Critically, no prior work experience is necessary—making CAPM accessible to career-changers and early-stage professionals entering Springfield's diverse job market.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your official PMI application and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the submission process to ensure your eligibility is confirmed and your application reaches PMI without delay.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to strengthen your knowledge across project management domains. Our instructors—active certified practitioners—provide targeted coaching so you enter the proctored CAPM exam confident and ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew on a three-year cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) by continuing your project management education, participating in professional activities, or advancing to the PMP credential to keep your certification current and competitive.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
